description: Provider-facing separable source payload for stopped-muon spectral BBN run. IDs are blinded.

arrays.E_MeV: neutrino energy grid corresponding to x
arrays.Q_EM_over_s: integrated EM energy source per entropy in MeV/s
arrays.Q_nu_over_s: integrated neutrino energy source per entropy in MeV/s
arrays.Q_pi_charged_over_s: charged-pion source; must be identically zero
